sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Capricorn climbs. The core impulse is to build something that lasts: reputation, craft, legacy. At best: steady, responsible, shrewd with time and energy. At worst: stoic to a fault, control over care, work as a shield. The win is sustainable pace and honest support.

Capricorn themes are loud in the 10th house (career/public role) across from the 4th house (roots, recovery). Track your Saturn sign + aspects—e.g., Saturn trine Sun (quiet authority), Mars sextile Saturn (disciplined drive), Moon square Saturn (feelings vs. duty).

✅ Strengths

  • Endurance, patience, trust with responsibility
  • Realism under pressure; clean priorities
  • Builds systems that outlast trends

⚠️ Friction Points

  • Work-first habits that starve rest and joy
  • Hyper-self-reliance; won’t ask until breaking
  • Perfection of outcome over clarity of process

🧭 Growth Moves

  • Define “enough” for each role (work/home/body)
  • Delegate before you resent
  • Schedule restoration like a deadline

sections.heading: How Capricorn Energy Behaves
sections.html:
Daily Life

  • Calendars, lists, quiet competence
  • Loves clear roles and measurable wins
  • Shows care by showing up on time

Under Stress

  • Takes on the whole mountain alone
  • Goes stoic; feelings get scheduled “later”
  • Reset: name limits, ask early, rest on purpose

Somatic Tells

  • Knee/low-back tightness from grind mode
  • Ease with posterior-chain strength + long walks
  • Breath deepens after “done for today” is said

sections.heading: Love & Sex
sections.html:
Dating a Capricorn

  • Consistency is romance; promises kept are hot
  • Plan quality time, not just “after work” leftovers
  • Affection grows with trust and track record

Sex with Capricorn

  • Slow burn; intention + presence
  • Privacy, safety, and clear consent open the body
  • Rituals and reliability keep desire warm

Attachment Triggers

  • Flakiness or showy promises without proof
  • Public disrespect
  • No plan for the future—name timelines together

sections.heading: Work & Money
sections.html:
Natural Lanes

  • Operations, architecture, finance, law/regulation
  • Founders, project leads, turnarounds
  • Any role where accountability = respect

Money Style

  • Thinks in decades; builds buffers first
  • Chooses quality tools over cheap churn
  • Automates saving; invests by thesis, not hype

Team Edge

  • Holds the line; ships on schedule
  • Calm in crisis; sets workable rules
  • Mentors by modeling standards

sections.heading: Growth Practices
sections.html:
Journal Prompts

  • What can I stop doing without losing the goal?
  • Where do I need help that I keep postponing?
  • How will I celebrate progress this week?

Bodywork

  • Posterior-chain strength + hip mobility
  • Contrast showers to reset stress
  • Evening downshift: screens off, stretch, breathe

Ritual

  • Weekly review: wins, blocks, next three steps
  • Quarterly theme with guardrails (hours, health)
  • “Done for today” alarm—honor it

sections.heading: Capricorn Decans
sections.html:
Decan I (≈ Dec 22–Dec 31) — Saturn

  • Classic Capricorn: disciplined, durable
  • Guard against self-denial disguised as grit

Decan II (≈ Jan 1–Jan 10) — Venus

  • Elegant builder; taste meets structure
  • Let pleasure be part of the plan

Decan III (≈ Jan 11–Jan 19) — Mercury

  • Strategic communicator; crisp executive function
  • Share the reasoning, not just the rule
